verdict.rationale: The only direct CLI evidence is an `attio migrate folder-structure` command in the App SDK docs, which shows an official `attio` CLI exists for app development. The SDK pitches AI-assisted development, and new apps come bootstrapped with AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files, though the docs do not say the CLI generates them. missing for 10: documentation of the CLI's command set and install, CLI-based workspace/data operations (records, lists, queries) for AI agents, AI-oriented CLI features such as JSON output or non-interactive auth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
